notes: The nearest report with a written chain is prev8 (174), whose chain opens with a different name and not with الحسن; how much of it this text takes over is uncertain, so the back-reference is written as it stands rather than inherited.
prev1 to prev7 open with «بهذا الإسناد» or are Imam sayings with no chain, and are passed over.
«عن أبي عبد الله ع» follows «عن» inside the chain, so the Imam stays a narrator (owner ruling 2).
